transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

I've been having a really hard time lately because people close to me keep saying that I don't listen to them when they talk to me. It feels like my mind just drifts off even when someone is speaking right to my face, and it's starting to cause some real issues.
Have you had this kind of trouble paying attention since childhood, like in school or at home, or did it start more recently? Was there any major stress or change going on around the time it began?

Honestly, I've struggled with this since childhood, definitely before age 12, so there wasn't any major life stress that suddenly triggered it. However, it has been particularly challenging and persistent over the last 9 months. It's just a long-standing issue from my youth that seems to have gotten harder to manage lately.
Over the past 6 months, have you been feeling anxious or worried most days about a lot of different things, and is that what makes it hard to focus?
No, I wouldn't say I feel anxious or worried most days. My focus issues don't really stem from anxiety or being stressed out about things.
Over the last 2 weeks, have you been feeling down or depressed, or have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?
No, I haven't really been feeling down or depressed lately. I still have plenty of interest in the things I usually enjoy doing.
Besides drifting off when people talk, do you also often have trouble staying organized, finishing tasks, or keeping track of things in more than one setting, like at work, home, or school?

Yes, I definitely struggle a lot with staying organized and managing my tasks. It's really hard for me to keep my schedule and papers in order, which makes it almost impossible to actually finish what I start, whether I'm at home or at work.
Do you also often lose things, get easily distracted, or forget appointments and daily responsibilities?
To be honest, I don't really experience those specific problems as far as I can tell. I don't usually lose my things, get easily distracted, or forget my appointments.
Do you often make careless mistakes, avoid tasks that need sustained mental effort, or have trouble following through on instructions even when you understand them?
I don't really experience those specific problems, to be honest. I haven't noticed making many careless mistakes, and I don't usually avoid tasks that require a lot of mental effort.
When people say you don’t listen, is it more that your mind wanders even though you’re trying to pay attention, or do you have any trouble actually hearing or understanding what they say?

It's definitely that my mind wanders, rather than any issue with my actual hearing or understanding. When people speak directly to me, my thoughts just drift off to something else even though I'm trying to pay attention. My hearing itself is actually perfectly fine.
When you were a child, did teachers or family often notice that you seemed not to listen, had trouble sustaining attention, or failed to finish schoolwork or chores?

Yes, absolutely. Ever since I was a young child, my teachers and family members would constantly complain that I didn't seem to listen when they spoke directly to me. They often felt like I was ignoring them, even though my mind was just drifting off.
Do you often have trouble sustaining attention during reading, meetings, or conversations, even when the topic is important to you?

I don't think I have a major issue with sustaining attention during reading or meetings specifically. It's really more about drifting off when someone is speaking directly to me, so I'm not sure if those other situations are a big problem for me.
